bit_numbering: inclusive [msb,lsb]; six channels packed least-significant channel first in H_HIGH,H_MID,H_LOW,V_HIGH,V_MID,V_LOW order
invalid_payload: Nonzero reserved fields invalidate context and prevent selection; count must be 1..16384
pipeline: four context join slots -> registered noise-energy and linearity results -> registered qualification result; each stage preserves full identity and honors downstream ready
capacity: Up to four joining contexts plus two pipeline-held results; occupied reports only joining pool, NOT global quiescence
identity_rule: Duplicate context identity rejected across both pool and pipeline; external owner still guarantees no stale key reuse after retirement/reset
overlap_rule: Frozen externally qualified overlap mask further excludes bad_channels; this does not infer valid overlap solely from no clipping
cancel: Discard both pipeline stages and pool; external bank lease and producer cancellation remain caller responsibilities
binding_boundary: No physical gains/pins/control codes hardcoded; context carries calibrated power normalization and explicit validity
not_implemented_here: physical bank admission and publication adapter
